claims.text: POL-NS-01(d) fails on the face of the trip record, and that failure is dispositive. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. This trip was terminated by the driver under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which the clause states in terms is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The driver's counterparty statement — 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' — says the same thing in his own words. With limb (d) broken the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause, and the dispute falls to be decided under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06 or POL-NS-10.

On the driver's own GPS trace the in-radius branch of the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE case is the one that applies, and that branch also produces a full refund. The trace shows 39 qualifying in-geofence fixes forming a single continuous run of 380 seconds from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, i.e. the driver held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 provides that where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item. Whatever the dwell, the fee does not stand.

Independently of the reason code, POL-NS-04 exonerates this rider and requires the fee to be refunded in full with no driver compensation. Limb (a): inside the waiting window, at 12:00:59, the rider sent 'at the lift lobby' — her own position, a locating/coordinating message. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message (nothing between 12:00:59 and 12:02:59, and nothing before he cancelled at 12:06:23), and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Limb (c): the rider's own track carries 67 fixes and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 67 of 67, with a maximum distance of about 15.5 m from the pickup pin — comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window. All three limbs hold.

No driver compensation can attach to this cancellation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01(d) fails here, so the condition precedent for any payout is absent and the anti-farming test on driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (0) against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (114) is never reached. The driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure of 2 is a lifetime counter, context only under POL-GEN-01, and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day counter named by the clause in either direction.

Even on the driver's most favourable alternative characterisation — that he held position outside the 50 m radius rather than inside it — POL-NS-03 still returns the fee to this rider in full, because the 400 m ceiling is the whole test and the wrong-entrance case refunds the cancellation fee to the rider. Compensation, if it were on the table at all, is denied by limb (i): the rider stated her sub-location in the chat_log ('at the lift lobby') and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:06:23, so the driver bears the loss. Limb (ii) cannot rescue him either: trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, so there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill to be awarded on these facts.

The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, and nobody else's money is in play. The ledger shows total_charged 4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider presently carries the disputed charge and a full refund leaves her not carrying it; under POL-GEN-03 FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount and does not restore the charge. The 4.50 line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50), so no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) distorts the figure, and no booking or platform fee is added to it.

This record is decidable and the deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts. Every artifact this brief relies on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown — is COMPLETE at weight 1.0. The one impaired item is EV-ADVIS-02723-01, a TRAFFIC_ADVISORY that is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT): no advisory covers this pickup. The rider relies on that absence only to close a door — the rider does not assert POL-NS-06(i) accumulation against a missing artifact, and limb (i) is simply unavailable, so no lawful-holding excuse can be built on it. Because the reason code and the driver's in-radius position rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, no POL-NS-08 impairment caps the confidence in this ruling and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation is engaged.

claims.text: The driver reached the pickup point: his own trace carries 39 consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, running without a break from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, so any suggestion that he never got to the pickup pin fails on the platform's own telemetry, and the arrival finding rests on a COMPLETE artifact at weight 1.0.

The driver held position inside that radius for a single continuous 380-second run, from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, against the 180-second free waiting period carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec on this record; the accumulated-dwell computation shows a shortfall of -200 seconds, that is a 200-second surplus, and because platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null no longer threshold applies, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own clock.

The 11:59:59 'I'm Here' event is not a false arrival marker for the purpose of POL-NS-05: the driver's track records a minimum distance of 0 m to the pickup pin and a stationary speed of 0.0 km/h at that moment, so neither trigger in that clause - a position more than 300 m from the pin, or travel at 15 km/h or more - is met, and the waiting clock does not need to be recomputed.

The rider's cleanest arithmetic route to a refund, a waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06, is not open on this record: 380 seconds of effective in-geofence dwell is longer than the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. The driver does not need, and does not rely on, the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation of separate intervals: no traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window (EV-ADVIS-02723-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), and his hold is a single continuous interval in any event.

The amount charged is arithmetically correct and carries no fare defect: the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, which resolution_rule makes the operative net figure for a record that carries platform_policy, and the ledger reconciles to total_charged with a reported difference of SGD 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and nothing in the fare evidence supports reducing the charge; the SGD 6.61 rider gross figure is an alternative the clause expressly permits the line to show.

Nothing in the driver's profile stands in the way of the payout POL-NS-07 fixes on a chargeable no-show: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 114, so the conjunctive anti-farming test - 4 or more no-show terminations and a rate above 0.08 - is not met, and compensation of SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, is not withheld.

The driver does not dispute that the reason code he selected, DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, is not one of the three codes limb (d) of POL-NS-01 recognises, and he does not ask the Judge to read it as one. The record nevertheless shows every other element of that limb - no boarding event, and termination at 12:06:23, which is 204 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 12:02:59 - so what is established is a labelling error on a pickup attempt that was in fact performed and waited out, which POL-NS-01 itself routes to the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item rather than to any adverse finding about the rider's conduct or about fee-farming.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02723 (fare breakdown EV-FARE-02723, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full.

The ground is limb (d) of POL-NS-01. That limb requires the trip to have been ended by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02723) shows it was ended by the driver at 12:06:23 under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which the clause states in terms is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The driver's chat message of 12:00:29 ('cannot find you, where are you') and his statement 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' say the same thing. The driver does not ask the Judge to read that code as one of the three, and the failure is dispositive: the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause (Rider claim 1 accepted; Driver claim 7 accepted only as a labelling error, whose consequence POL-NS-01 fixes as below).

The driver did reach the pickup and did wait. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02723, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) places him 0 m from the pin and stationary at the 11:59:59 'I'm Here' tap, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and the arrival marker is not false (Driver claim 3 accepted). He then held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 380 seconds, 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, against the 180-second free waiting period in force on this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). There is therefore no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06 (Driver claim 4 accepted) and limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied (Driver claim 2 accepted). Limb (c) alone does not make the fee chargeable, because limb (d) breaks.

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 states the consequence itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the referrals as a driver-education item. That is this ruling (Rider claim 2 accepted). The rider's own conduct does not alter it: POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider — she sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 12:00:59; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of it nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and her device recorded 67 qualifying fixes, all within about 15.5 m of the pin, well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius (Rider claim 3 accepted). Both routes agree.

Driver compensation: none. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) is not, so the condition precedent fails and the payout is never reached (Rider claim 4 accepted). The anti-farming test is not the reason — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against 114 completed trips in 30 days, so the check would not trip (Driver claim 6 correct on that point) — but compensation simply does not arise. The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags (2) is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was correctly not used as a ground by either side.

POL-NS-03 does not govern: it applies where the stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, and here they lie inside. The rider's alternative reasoning under it is therefore not reached, and nothing in it changes the outcome (Rider claim 5 not engaged).

Amount: the sum returned is the cancellation-fee line, SGD 4.50, matching fare_breakdown.total_charged (4.50) and platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50); no booking, platform or waiting-time fee is added, and the waiting-time line is 0.00 (Rider claim 6 accepted). No fare-integrity defect arises under POL-NS-08(d) — the line reconciles with a reported difference of SGD 0.00 (Driver claim 5 accepted).

No escalation: every deciding fact is carried by unimpaired artifacts at weight 1.0, the GPS trace and the trip record, so no POL-NS-08 cap applies and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The one impaired artifact, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02723-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0), carries no deciding fact and is relied on by neither party for one (Rider claim 7 accepted). Confidence 0.95, capped at the minimum weight (1.0) among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically on issue. This is a provisional automated ruling; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, you are refunded the full SGD 4.50 cancellation fee. Driver, the fee you charged does not stand, and no compensation is payable to you on this trip.

The underlying facts are not in dispute. You reached the pickup at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 (EV-GPS-02723: a single continuous run of 39 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, 380 seconds, minimum distance to the pin 0 m), you pressed 'I'm Here' at 11:59:59 (EV-TRIP-02723), and you cancelled at 12:06:23. Your dwell of 380 seconds exceeded the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and your arrival marker was not false — you were stationary at the pin, neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or more — so POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 give the rider no shortcut and take nothing from you on those points. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message (nothing between 12:00:59 and 12:02:59, and nothing before he cancelled at 12:06:23), and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Limb (c): the rider's own track carries 67 fixes and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 67 of 67, with a maximum distance of about 15.5 m from the pickup pin — comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window. All three limbs hold.

No driver compensation can attach to this cancellation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01(d) fails here, so the condition precedent for any payout is absent and the anti-farming test on driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (0) against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (114) is never reached. The driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure of 2 is a lifetime counter, context only under POL-GEN-01, and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day counter named by the clause in either direction.

ledger.claim: Even on the driver's most favourable alternative characterisation — that he held position outside the 50 m radius rather than inside it — POL-NS-03 still returns the fee to this rider in full, because the 400 m ceiling is the whole test and the wrong-entrance case refunds the cancellation fee to the rider. Compensation, if it were on the table at all, is denied by limb (i): the rider stated her sub-location in the chat_log ('at the lift lobby') and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:06:23, so the driver bears the loss. Limb (ii) cannot rescue him either: trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, so there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill to be awarded on these facts.

The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, and nobody else's money is in play. The ledger shows total_charged 4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider presently carries the disputed charge and a full refund leaves her not carrying it; under POL-GEN-03 FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount and does not restore the charge. The 4.50 line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50), so no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) distorts the figure, and no booking or platform fee is added to it.

This record is decidable and the deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts. Every artifact this brief relies on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown — is COMPLETE at weight 1.0. The one impaired item is EV-ADVIS-02723-01, a TRAFFIC_ADVISORY that is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT): no advisory covers this pickup. The rider relies on that absence only to close a door — the rider does not assert POL-NS-06(i) accumulation against a missing artifact, and limb (i) is simply unavailable, so no lawful-holding excuse can be built on it. Because the reason code and the driver's in-radius position rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, no POL-NS-08 impairment caps the confidence in this ruling and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation is engaged.

The driver reached the pickup point: his own trace carries 39 consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, running without a break from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, so any suggestion that he never got to the pickup pin fails on the platform's own telemetry, and the arrival finding rests on a COMPLETE artifact at weight 1.0.

The driver held position inside that radius for a single continuous 380-second run, from 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, against the 180-second free waiting period carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec on this record; the accumulated-dwell computation shows a shortfall of -200 seconds, that is a 200-second surplus, and because platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null no longer threshold applies, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own clock.

The 11:59:59 'I'm Here' event is not a false arrival marker for the purpose of POL-NS-05: the driver's track records a minimum distance of 0 m to the pickup pin and a stationary speed of 0.0 km/h at that moment, so neither trigger in that clause - a position more than 300 m from the pin, or travel at 15 km/h or more - is met, and the waiting clock does not need to be recomputed.

The rider's cleanest arithmetic route to a refund, a waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06, is not open on this record: 380 seconds of effective in-geofence dwell is longer than the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. The driver does not need, and does not rely on, the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation of separate intervals: no traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window (EV-ADVIS-02723-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), and his hold is a single continuous interval in any event.

The amount charged is arithmetically correct and carries no fare defect: the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, which resolution_rule makes the operative net figure for a record that carries platform_policy, and the ledger reconciles to total_charged with a reported difference of SGD 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and nothing in the fare evidence supports reducing the charge; the SGD 6.61 rider gross figure is an alternative the clause expressly permits the line to show.

Nothing in the driver's profile stands in the way of the payout POL-NS-07 fixes on a chargeable no-show: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 114, so the conjunctive anti-farming test - 4 or more no-show terminations and a rate above 0.08 - is not met, and compensation of SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, is not withheld.

The driver does not dispute that the reason code he selected, DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, is not one of the three codes limb (d) of POL-NS-01 recognises, and he does not ask the Judge to read it as one. The record nevertheless shows every other element of that limb - no boarding event, and termination at 12:06:23, which is 204 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 12:02:59 - so what is established is a labelling error on a pickup attempt that was in fact performed and waited out, which POL-NS-01 itself routes to the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item rather than to any adverse finding about the rider's conduct or about fee-farming.
